headline: Makes the same purchase at Mercadona 20 years later and compares product prices: "This is madness"
summary: A cheapest-available basket replicating a 2004 purchase at Mercadona rises from 52 to 115 euros, according to a comparison by a consumer columnist. The analysis is a single-shop price check.
why: Mercadona is Spain's largest supermarket chain by sales, and grocery price trends feed into Spanish inflation and household purchasing power.

original_headline: Hace la misma compra en Mercadona 20 años después y compara el precio de sus productos: "Esto es una locura"
